body:
GREG, 2026-11-17 about 01:28-01:36Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1408, #1410 and #1414), verbatim: „Czekamy na sync. Mogę przenieść development na macos. Chodzi mi głównio o Comovo.” then „Skończmy sync. Jak zadziała to zaczniemy testy na comovo. To nie zmienia planów.” then „Parę dni to za dużo. + Kimi. Co realnie brakuje. Różnicę ogarnę w Comovo. Aby pracować muszę mieć jakoś zaimplementovaný sync.” Meaning: find the SHORTEST path to usable Windows<->Mac task and memory sync for Comovo (repo aolowko/fit_friends, Flutter, 234 tasks in the Central Engram store, sync off). Greg resolves Comovo-side differences himself; no extra requirements; don't delay other P0s.
SHORTEST PATH (Engram::Fable, independently confirmed by Kimi c15db92c #300):
- master's `task-sync data-init`, `export --include-memories` and `import --include-memories --empty-basis` work on any platform (src/bin_support/task_sync.rs:776-817; tests/task_sync_cli/memories.rs:104-145). Only Engram's BUILT-IN Git fetch/push is Windows-only (src/task_sync/exchange/mod.rs:34-49, UnsupportedPlatform), and that's w-6bba, NOT required. The manual route is plain git fetch, merge --ff-only and push of the engram-data branch (docs/skills/engram-use/SKILL.md).
- Caveat: w-443806ecaf50 (w-4438), where a repeat export with memories refuses once the data branch holds memories and tasks changed, is fixed inside dd205. So bootstrap works on master; repeatable exchange with memories needs the dd205 restart set landed.
- Plan: the restart set (dd205 R18u + ea4a + 606e) lands; Greg's restart; the Mac installs that master (the Mac has build 8bbf9d60 / rev 0bd70a30 and no store); `engram init` on the Mac; Comovo on Central: task-sync enable, data-init --branch engram-data, export --include-memories, commit, push; the Mac: data-init, fetch, import --include-memories --empty-basis.
- Greg's yes is requested at 43498a6e #1415 for (a) the Mac install and store, and (b) pushing engram-data to the private fit_friends.
Mac facts (01:33Z): checkout /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/fit_friends, main at b39c0e11 (rincon-common submodule at a different revision, "+"). Flutter 3.47.2, Dart 3.13.2, Xcode 27.1, CocoaPods 1.17.0, Java 23, Android SDK present (ANDROID_HOME unset). C6A9's real two-host proof is Windows<->DL560, not yet Windows<->Mac.
